'''Greg Marshall Comlink''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Marshall]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Death Star: War Room]]
* '''Strategy:''' Comlink
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Comlink Marshall DS 1996 Designs.txt |Download]]

'''Location'''

* 1x [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]]
* 1x [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley]]
* 1x [[Yavin 4: Docking Bay]]
* 1x [[Strategies: Basically, this is a dark side version of a lightside CZ-3 deck. The object is to have a high ability imperial (>3) at a location with a comlink, preferably at a central location on Tatooine, where you will be doing your draining. Have MANY cards in your hand, and several troopers and force available for any trooper guards in your hand. What this means is generating as MUCH force as possible in the first few turns, and drawing all of it. Once you have a few troopers down (even as few as three!) you can start using the Full Scale Alerts to block your oponent's movement when you timer mine them, since the average destiny in this deck is around 2.5. You may wish to drop more than one mine at once, due to the low destiny of this deck]]
